SYC.note: Names an Information Commission among integrity bodies but says nothing of an access to information law or its use.
Nothing on digital financial services consumer protection.
Mentions data protection safeguards for a proposed portal only; no law stated.
The e-participation portal is proposed, not in service; no online consultation shown to have run.
Nothing on government staff building or running systems.

facts.fact: A validation session on 20 November 2026 brought Government, civil society and independent governance institutions together to review and endorse three commitments, including a digital public participation (e-participation portal) commitment, for the Third OGP National Action Plan, which was co-created with civil society and others.
